channel.title: RateLog — Devin Desktop (formerly Windsurf) changelog
channel.description: Every pricing and usage-limit change RateLog has caught for Devin Desktop (formerly Windsurf), dated and sourced — no other tools mixed in.

item.title: Devin Desktop (formerly Windsurf) — Teams pricing structure clarified
item.description: [changed] Resolved earlier conflicting reports about Teams pricing: it’s a hybrid model, not a flat per-seat rate — $80/mo minimum team spend, $40/mo per full seat (Pro-equivalent quota + Desktop access), and unlimited free flex seats (shared credits, no Desktop access).

item.title: Devin Desktop (formerly Windsurf) — Rebranded to "Devin Desktop"
item.description: [changed] Cognition rebranded the Windsurf IDE as “Devin Desktop,” unifying it with the cloud agent Devin under one product and opening it to third-party agents via the open Agent Client Protocol.

item.title: Devin Desktop (formerly Windsurf) — Flat credits replaced with daily/weekly quotas; Pro price up
item.description: [↓ reduced] Cognition replaced flat monthly credit-pool billing with a token-based system giving daily + weekly usage allowances, raised Pro from $15→$20/mo and Teams from $30→$40/seat/mo (both reportedly grandfathered for existing subscribers), and launched a new $200/mo Max tier.
